subject: Water-system visibility alongside Digital Realty’s facility controls
body:
Hello,

I saw Digital Realty is expanding data-center capacity in Singapore and has described using BMS monitoring across its Singapore facilities, including work on chilled-water operating temperatures.

Nexa provides water-system sensing, alerts, reporting, and centralized visibility for building water assets, including selected hydronic and cooling-tower use cases. We would not assume this replaces existing BMS coverage; rather, I’m reaching out to see whether there are sites where your team is evaluating more water-specific monitoring or leak-risk visibility.

Would a brief conversation with the team responsible for facilities engineering, critical-environment operations, or sustainability be useful to determine whether there is a fit?

personalization_evidence.claim: Digital Realty says it uses BMS to monitor more than 30,000 infrastructure points across its Singapore facilities and has collaborated on higher chilled-water operating temperatures.
Digital Realty is expanding data-center capacity in Singapore and Switzerland.

call_to_action: Ask for a short discovery conversation or routing to the appropriate facilities-engineering, critical-operations, or sustainability owner.

subject: Qualifying water visibility across AvalonBay communities
body:
Hello,

AvalonBay publicly reports 98,271 apartment homes and identifies sustainability solutions that reduce impact, expenses, and risk as a strategic focus.

Nexa helps building teams monitor water movement, receive alerts on abnormal activity, and gain centralized visibility across suitable properties. For a portfolio of managed apartment communities, I thought it could be useful to understand whether water use, leak response, metering, or shutoff visibility is managed consistently today.

Would you be open to a short exploratory discussion, or could you direct me to the property-operations, facilities, or sustainability team that evaluates these systems?

personalization_evidence.claim: AvalonBay reports 98,271 apartment homes as of March 31, 2026.
AvalonBay identifies value-enhancing sustainability solutions to reduce impact, expenses, and risk as a strategic focus area.

call_to_action: Ask for a brief exploratory conversation or referral to property operations, facilities, or sustainability.

subject: Water-specific visibility for BXP’s actively managed office assets
body:
Hello,

BXP’s ESG reporting describes an actively managed office portfolio, long-term water-consumption goals, and an operational-monitoring program using real-time infrastructure data. It also identifies flooding, water costs, and business continuity among property-related considerations.

Nexa provides building-water sensing, alerts, reports, and multi-property visibility for selected commercial real-estate use cases. We would not presume a gap in BXP’s existing EIS or BMS tools, but I’d welcome the chance to learn whether any properties would benefit from more water-specific monitoring or leak-risk visibility.

Would a 20-minute discovery call with the relevant property-management, engineering, or sustainability leader be worthwhile?

personalization_evidence.claim: BXP says it has long-term water goals, reported water-use reduction, and assigns asset-level energy, emissions, water, and waste targets to regional managers and heads of property management.
BXP describes real-time monitoring infrastructure and notes water, flooding, and business-continuity considerations in its property-risk discussion.

call_to_action: Ask for a 20-minute discovery call with the relevant property-management, engineering, or sustainability owner.
